title: Spectrum prediction and machine-learning generalization
zh_title: 谱图预测与机器学习泛化
summary: Define prediction targets, split by the intended generalization unit, and separate similarity, retention transfer, ranking, and confidence calibration.
zh_summary: 定义预测目标，按预期泛化单位划分数据，并区分相似度、保留行为迁移、排序及置信度校准。

title: Benchmarking computational mass spectrometry
zh_title: 计算质谱方法的基准评估
summary: Build fair comparisons with independent reference evidence, declared preprocessing and partitions, task-matched metrics, and checked error-control assumptions.
zh_summary: 利用独立参考证据、明确预处理与划分、对应任务的指标及经过检查的错误控制假设，建立公平比较。

title: Open data formats and analysis provenance
zh_title: 开放数据格式与分析溯源
summary: Choose mzML, mzIdentML, and mzTab for their respective information layers, then preserve sample relationships, vocabulary meaning, and transformation history.
zh_summary: 根据各自信息层级选择 mzML、mzIdentML 和 mzTab，并保留样本关系、词汇含义及转换历史。
